environments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait 360:560 mobile casual-game environment, high resolution. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: capture its bright saturated polished 2.5D hand-painted mobile farm-game finish, softly rounded modeled forms, clearly shaded wood/stone/toy materials, cheerful sunlit atmosphere, and readable tidy scene construction. Create an entirely new original environment, not the pictured farm, people or train. No phone frame, UI, controls, text, letters, numbers, signs, logos, watermarks, game characters, cars or other live game pieces. Camera is an elevated three-quarter/isometric-ish view looking toward the upper edge. Keep the middle 60% of the width and the middle 80% of the height unobstructed and comparatively simple, suitable for separately rendered interactive sprites. Put charming dimensional environmental details around outermost sides and corners only. No flat vector illustration, pixel art, geometric placeholder shapes, low-poly shapes, ornate fantasy filigree, purple spectral creatures, photorealism or clutter.
Scene: a colorful friendly small-town racing avenue. One clearly readable wide blue-gray paved road runs vertically from bottom to top, center mostly clear with a subtle narrow dashed cream centerline. Thick curb edges, cheerful red-roof toy-scale houses, cropped sidewalk planters and round green trees at far sides only; warm sunlight, blue sky glimpsed only at top. Richly painted high-end casual game background, no cars or people.
environments.visual_qa: reviewed: bright dimensional cartoon environment, clean center, no UI or characters
